title: Chief of Police
key_finding: The city police website identifies Chief Jason Fields and describes him as leading the officers and civilians of the Fort Myers Police Department.

title: Districts
key_finding: FMPD's official districts page shows North, South, West, and Central policing districts, which is direct evidence of an active city policing structure.

title: Emergency 9-1-1 Center
key_finding: FMPD says its Emergency 9-1-1 Center is the primary PSAP within the geographic boundaries of the City of Fort Myers and transfers requests for service outside the city to the appropriate outside agency.

title: Obtain Copy of Police Report
key_finding: FMPD says all police reports generated by officers and Community Service Aides are retained by the Records Division of the Fort Myers Police Department at 2210 Widman Way.

title: Fort Myers Police Department Annual Report 2024
key_finding: The 2024 annual report says Fort Myers Police Department personnel addressed 128,462 calls for service in 2024, Patrol Operations is responsible for day-to-day police operations, and the department operates as a current city police agency under Chief Jason Fields.

title: Budget | Fort Myers
column7: The City's budget page publishes current adopted budget documents and confirms that Fort Myers maintains a formal city budgeting process for ongoing municipal operations.

title: FY2025-2026 Adopted Annual Budget Book
key_finding: The FY2025-2026 adopted budget book includes Police Department and Dispatchers sections in the table of contents and funds police vehicles, COPS grant matching funds, and a new police headquarters project.

title: Patrol Bureau
key_finding: Lee County Sheriff's Office maintains its own patrol bureau and county precinct system, which supports treating LCSO as a separate county layer rather than the primary Fort Myers city police department.

title: County and Municipal Offense Report 2020A
key_finding: FDLE's 2020 county-and-municipal offense report lists Fort Myers Police Department as a municipal row with population 92,599 and total index crime 2,166.

title: FIBRS Offense Detail 2021-2025 Q3 workbook
key_finding: The official FDLE 2024 FIBRS sheet includes Fort Myers Police Department in Lee County with four quarters reported and nonzero violent, property, and other year-to-date totals.
